title: Chthonic Archive Character
description: Canonical schema for game/lore/characters/<organ>/<tier>/*.json. Derived from the_sourcer.json (Blazing Trial worked artifact, 2026-05-25) and SSOT §295-326 Organ-Level Entity Canon. Faction/organ/tier-aware; physical block optional but recommended for WHR:MAX-bearing entities.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file for editor tooling. e.g. '../../character.schema.json'.

character_id.description: Lowercase snake_case. MUST match the filename (without .json). Stable reference key across all cross-references.

name.description: Full canonical name. Honorific + given + family form (e.g. 'Dr. Lysandra Thorne', 'Madam Umeko Ketsuraku').

title.description: Operational title / epithet (e.g. 'Truth Extractor', 'The Sourcer — Lane-Walker of the Reconciliation').

faction.description: Canonical faction designation. Known values include CRC, HCOU-SAI, Decorator-Tier; novel factions allowed.

tier.description: Tier level. Half-tiers allowed for sub-bridges (e.g. 1.5 between T1-bridge and T2).

tier_path_deferred.description: OPTIONAL. Present when tier placement is a deferred decision (Path A vs Path B, etc.). The conductor disposes.

linguistic_mode.description: Short code (LUPLR, LIPAA, EULP_AA, LCD). Uppercase, underscores only — no hyphens (normalized 2026-05-27).

linguistic_mode_full.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED. Full expansion of the linguistic_mode code with operational description.

chain.description: Functional chain: Truth, Chaos, Purification, Verification, Ordeal, Innate-Cytotoxic, etc.

spectral_frequency_note.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED. Why this spectral frequency was assigned (symbolic rationale).

district_note.description: OPTIONAL. Operational note about what the district means for this character.

organ.description: Canonical organ per SSOT §295-326 Organ-Level Entity Canon. MUST match the parent directory slug (slugified: 'Natural Killer (NK) Cells' → 'nk_cells'). For deferred organ assignment, use '_deferred_organ'.

body_system.description: Body system per SSOT §299 column (Digestive, Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Immune, etc.). For deferred, use '_deferred'.

description.description: REQUIRED per upgraded schema (2026-05-27). Every ability must self-describe.

appearance.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED. Physical and bearing description.

voice_register.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED. How the character speaks (cadence, vocabulary, footnoting habits).

activation_tell.description: OPTIONAL. Observable signal that precedes activation.

relationship_dynamics.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED. Keys are character_id of the other entity. Values are operational descriptions of the relationship.

implements.description: OPTIONAL. @SID list of protocols this character implements.

deferred_decisions.description: OPTIONAL. Decisions not yet ruled by the conductor. Keys are decision names; values are descriptions including the open question.

session_origin.description: OPTIONAL. Session ID or short description of authoring context. MUST NOT contain absolute filesystem paths.

tides.description: OPTIONAL. Tidal interaction pattern for tide-bearing entities (typically T3+ immune/cellular operatives).

circuit.description: OPTIONAL. Circuit topology for circuit-bearing entities (typically immune/cellular T3+).

physical.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED for WHR:MAX-bearing entities per SSOT tri-axis canon. Adopted by CRC quartet 2026-05-27.

out_of_scope_acknowledgment.description: OPTIONAL. Top-level metadata about repo scope; deliberately outside the lore block to keep lore narrative-only.
